fusions.name: Dropped Weight
fusions.desc: Drops from a line overhead, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each 3 tiles back and leaves it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crush the Wrapped
fusions.desc: A flattening blow deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and uses up every affliction on it, with 60% more damage for each one used up.

fusions.name: Beaten Mat
fusions.desc: Strings a flattened mat of strands 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Softened for the Blow
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
